title: 第十九章 花里胡哨的选手们第二十章 好聚好散
slug: 穿进男频爽文反派师尊科学修仙
lines: 向西南飞行三天后，众人被游云鲤送到一处绵延万里的山脉密林之间。
层峦叠嶂的原始森林之中有一处常人难以察觉的灵力荡漾，那里就是众人此行的目的地。
解清玄将游云鲤停在参天树冠，挥挥手带着众弟子跳入密林缝隙间的一片小空地。随后将游云鲤收入一只云纹小木钵再存入纳戒。
空地周围已经聚集了百十来号人，凡是中土有些名声的正派仙家都派来了队伍探宝，此时都已等候在那秘境入口的山洞前，静待五大派轮值的二位长老布阵开启秘境。
今年轮值开门的好像是兽语林和南霜宫的长老，反正没有解清玄什么事，她也只需要耐心等待。
这秘境五十年间有七日可供仙家进入探宝。
七日时间对于仙家来说足够扫荡，但秘境中的天材地宝却大多要千百年才能成熟，经不起修仙者五十年一次的扫荡，所以各大门派编规定，每个门派每次只能派十人进入。七天之内能取多少宝贝倒是各凭本事。
有能力的高修为之人不会稀罕秘境外围那些凡品药材灵兽便没道理去欺负抢夺晚辈的资源。偶有大佬们看中了同样宝贝也大多因为门派颜面不会闹得太难看。
总之千百年来这秘境中虽有小摩擦，却也没发展成明面上的门派械斗，正派仙家都还是要些面子的。
至于私下里的杀人夺宝，若是没人看到便也无人在意，没有什么门派会为了门下一两个弟子去破了面子上的和谐。
所以原主解清玄夺段莫弃灵根这事嘛，更是流云宗自家的“家事”。原著中流云宗宁息人事不了了之，男主这才去寻了私仇做掉了原主。
仔细想想，如果是解清玄遇到这种事兴许只会一走了之，不会回去杀原主。毕竟炎龙灵根比他之前的地级杂质灵根好上许多，而且那时候他修为还与原主差着一段，杀人着实费心费力，解清玄是想想就觉得麻烦。
但段莫弃是个有仇必报的主，毕竟男频文，男主杀伐不果断作者肯定是要被喷成筛子的。
解清玄揣着架子耐心等候，脑子里胡思乱想着，又闲得无聊打量起周围穿得五颜六色的修仙者们。
不得不说，在这群花里胡哨的人群里，段莫弃光凭那身高和外表就能从中脱颖而出。只是不知为什么，他仿佛是自带什么降低存在感的buff似的，周围交头接耳互相打探情报的修士没有一个往段莫弃这边来的。
人群中解清玄能分辨出来的人物不多。
与流云宗队伍最近的是黄风岭。领头的那个黄袍、山羊胡老大爷应当就是黄风岭的二把手。秘境里看中了段莫弃寻到的【尘晶】，“说服”他“让”了出来，导致段莫弃不得不更加深入秘境寻找炼丹材料。
稍远处，兽语林队伍中一位穿着暴露，托着只松鼠的性感大姐姐，应该是白筱林。
她是兽语林掌门之女，在文中是人气很高的大姐姐，读者都以为她会是女主，结果在秘境篇过后就去打了酱油。直到后面的兽语林之灾短暂出场，又悄无声息的下线了。
也是到后来直男作者才标注，本书无女主，读者们扭头一看，才发现剧情到这潜龙秘境之前竟是一个女性角色都没有，这位兽语林的白筱林竟是与男主有过对手戏的第一个异性……
总之，书中白筱林的伴生灵兽松鼠能嗅到木系高阶地宝的方位，她也是人美心善为男主指了条路，却导致男主找到了秘境深处解清玄五十年前标记的一株待熟【藤木之晶】。
远处，一群背着各种奇怪法器，带着黑色兜帽的一行人是藏雾阁的。其中一位背着镰刀，柄上挂着一只突兀白色绒球装饰的蒙面俊男是男主未来的好兄弟。
‘没想到他原来这么早就出场过？’解清玄当时读原著的时候竟然没有注意到，又或者原著里其实根本就没写这种细节。
人群中，最后一个能让解清玄认出来的角色便是一位留着非主流炸毛银发又不穿上衣的散漫小哥。
他是个法外狂徒散修。
因为没有门派愿意出手管教，所以每次秘境开启都会混进来些散修。大多数散修混进去也是夹着尾巴做人，而这位莫西干小哥是那一小部分比较嚣张的。
也就是他尾随男主段莫弃找到了原主标记的藤木之晶，意图夺宝。结果却是被修为低于他的男主越级反杀，而他身上带的【水玉魂】与【藤木之晶】偶然融合，将男主的灵根提炼为至纯地级水木灵根，这才让姗姗来迟的原主解清玄动了夺灵根的心思。
也不知这次段莫弃会不会再次碰见他，若是碰见了，如今只有炼气末期的他又该怎么跨两段反杀结丹初期的暴躁小哥呢……
“师尊。师尊？”
段莫弃的声音把解清玄的思绪拉回眼前。
“秘境之门开启了。”
“哦哦！哦哦！咳咳。”
她赶紧把松懈下来的身子站得笔直，端起架子正色对身后晚辈们说：“流云弟子们注意！若是在秘境之中遇到危险可发射门派信号，我会尽快赶去，若是有同门在附近也务必前去相助！诸位可记住了！”
“是，源述长老！”流云宗的老老少少齐声回答，各个神采奕奕，很有精神！
虽是如此却也不知有多少人能把解清玄上面那些话当真。这些话只是叶问秋嘱咐她说的“例行公事场面话”，在这个弱肉强食的世界人们大多都是自顾不暇，哪有余力去照拂别人。
但当然也并不是所有人都是如此冷漠。流云队伍中就有位大叔仗义出手帮了段莫弃一把，只是时运不济，二人分开后他因采药不慎，死在一只鸩鸟爪下。
天道无情，好人好报只是凡人的一厢情愿。
解清玄想出口提醒一下那位大叔小心鸩鸟，却也不知道这几位大叔中哪个才是他……
“好了，你们去吧，万事小心，天材地宝没有命重要。七天后务必都给我囫囵着出来！”她也只能如此去提醒一下众人了。
“祝诸位好运！”
一行人向解清玄行礼后便纷纷掐诀飞身进入洞内光门。
“段莫弃，你等等。”解清玄叫住了队伍末尾的段莫弃。
content_en:
After flying southwest for three days, everyone was sent to a dense forest stretching thousands of miles by Yunyunli.
Among the mountains and hills of the primeval forest, there is a spiritual power that is difficult to detect by ordinary people. That is the destination of everyone's trip.
Jie Qingxuan stopped the wandering carp in the crown of the towering tree, waved his hand and led the disciples to jump into a small open space between the gaps in the dense forest. Then put the wandering carp into a small wooden bowl with cloud patterns and store it in the ring.
A hundred or so people have gathered around the clearing. All the decent immortal families in Middle-earth with some reputation have sent teams to hunt for treasures. At this time, they are waiting in front of the cave at the entrance of the secret realm, waiting for the two elders of the five major sects to set up a formation to open the secret realm.
It seems that the elders of Beast Whispering Forest and Nanshuang Palace are taking turns opening the door this year. Anyway, Qingxuan has nothing to do with her, so she just needs to wait patiently.
There are seven days in this secret realm for the immortal family to enter and explore for treasures in fifty years.
Seven days is enough time for the Immortal Family to clean up, but most of the heavenly materials and earthly treasures in the secret realm take thousands of years to mature, and cannot withstand the once-in-fifty-year sweep by immortal cultivators. Therefore, each sect has stipulated that each sect can only send ten people in at a time. How many treasures can be retrieved within seven days depends on everyone's ability.
Capable people with high level of cultivation will not care about those ordinary medicinal materials and spiritual beasts outside the secret realm, so they have no reason to bully and rob the resources of the juniors. Occasionally, big bosses would like the same treasure, mostly because the sect's appearance would not cause too much trouble.
In short, although there have been small frictions in this secret realm for thousands of years, they have not developed into open sect fighting. The decent immortal families still want to save some face.
As for killing people and seizing treasures in private, if no one sees it, no one will care. No sect would destroy the harmony in appearance for the sake of one or two disciples.
Therefore, the original owner Xie Qingxuan's seizure of Duan Mo Qi's spiritual root was a "family matter" of the Liuyun Sect. In the original work, Liuyun Zong wanted to settle down and let things go, so the male protagonist went to seek personal revenge and killed the original owner.
Thinking about it carefully, if Jie Qingxuan encountered such a thing, he would probably just leave and not go back to kill the original owner. After all, the Yanlong spiritual root was much better than his previous earth-level impurity spiritual root, and at that time, his cultivation level was still far behind the original owner. Killing people was really laborious and laborious, and Jie Qingxuan found it troublesome just thinking about it.
But Duan Moqi is a hero who must avenge himself. After all, if the male protagonist is not decisive in his killing, the author will definitely be sprayed into a sieve.
Xie Qingxuan waited patiently with an air of humility, his mind wandering with random thoughts, and he was so bored that he looked at the colorfully dressed immortal cultivators around him.
It has to be said that among this group of flashy people, Duan Moqi can stand out just by his height and appearance. But for some reason, he seemed to have some kind of buff that reduced his presence. None of the monks who were whispering around him to inquire about information came to Duan Mo Qi.
There were not many people in the crowd that Jie Qingxuan could distinguish.
The one closest to the Liuyun Sect team is Huangfengling. The old man with the yellow robe and goatee in the lead should be Huang Fengling's second in command. In the secret realm, he took a fancy to the [Chen Crystal] that Duan Moqi found and "persuaded" him to "let" it out, causing Duan Moqi to have to go deeper into the secret realm to search for alchemy materials.
A little further away, a sexy big sister in the Beast Whispering Forest team was wearing scantily clad clothes and holding a squirrel. She should be Bai Xiaolin.
She is the daughter of the head of the Beast Whispering Forest, and she is a very popular eldest sister in the novel. Readers thought she would be the heroine, but after the Secret Realm chapter, she was left alone. It wasn't until the Disaster of Beast Whispering Forest made a brief appearance later that it quietly went offline again.
It was only later that the straight male author marked that there was no female protagonist in this book. When readers turned around and took a look, they discovered that there was no female character before the plot reached the hidden dragon secret realm. Bai Xiaolin from the Beast Whispering Forest was actually the first person of the opposite sex to have played opposite the male protagonist...
In short, in the book, the squirrel, the companion spirit beast of Bai Xiaolin, can smell the location of high-level wood-type treasures. She is also kind and kind-hearted and points out the way for the male protagonist, but it leads him to find a ripe [vine tree crystal] deep in the secret realm that Jie Qingxuan marked fifty years ago.
In the distance, a group of people carrying various strange magic weapons and wearing black hoods were from the Hidden Mist Pavilion. One of them, a handsome masked man carrying a sickle with an unexpected white pompom hanging on the handle, is the hero's future good brother.
‘I didn’t expect him to appear so early? ’ Xie Qingxuan didn’t notice it when he read the original work, or perhaps there was no such detail in the original work.
Among the crowd, the last character that Jie Qingxuan could recognize was a sloppy guy with unconventional silver hair and no shirt.
He is an outlaw cultivator.
Because no sect is willing to take action to discipline them, some casual cultivators will sneak in every time the secret realm is opened. Most casual cultivators sneak in with their tail between their legs, but this mohawk guy is one of the more arrogant ones.
That is to say, he followed the male protagonist Duan Mo Qi to find the Vinewood Crystal marked by the original owner, with the intention of seizing the treasure. In the end, he was overthrown and killed by the male protagonist who was lower than him in cultivation. The [Water Jade Soul] and [Wine Crystal] he carried accidentally merged, refining the male protagonist's spiritual root into the purest earth-level water-wood spiritual root. This made the belated original owner Jie Qingxuan start to seize the spiritual root.
I don’t know if Duan Moqi will meet him again this time. If he does, how can he, who is only at the end of Qi refining stage, cross two stages to counter-kill the irascible brother in the early stage of pill formation...
"Master. Master?"
Duan Moqi's voice brought Xie Qingxuan's thoughts back to his eyes.
"The door to the secret realm is opened."
"Oh! Oh! Ahem."
She quickly straightened her relaxed body and said sternly to the juniors behind her: "Attention, disciples of Liuyun! If you encounter danger in the secret realm, you can send out the sect signal, and I will rush there as soon as possible. If there are fellow sects nearby, you must go to help! Remember!"
"Yes, Elder Yuanshu!" The old and young of Liuyun Sect replied in unison, all of them were full of energy and energy!
Even so, I don't know how many people can take what Jie Qingxuan said above seriously. These words were just "routine words" that Ye Wenqiu asked her to say. In this world where the jungle prevails, most people have too much time to take care of themselves and have no time to take care of others.
But of course not everyone is so indifferent. There was an uncle in Liuyun's team who generously helped Duan Moqi, but bad luck happened. After the two separated, he died under the claws of a poisonous bird due to carelessness in collecting medicine.
God is merciless, and good people are rewarded. It is just the wishful thinking of mortals.
Xie Qingxuan wanted to remind the uncle to be careful, but he didn't know which of these uncles was him...
"Okay, you go, be careful in everything, the treasures of heaven and earth are not as important as life. You must come out alive after seven days!" This was all she could do to remind everyone.
"Good luck to you all!"
After the group of people saluted Jie Qingxuan, they all made secrets and flew into the light door of the cave.
"Duan Moqi, wait a minute." Xie Qingxuan called to Duan Moqi, who was at the end of the team.
